notes: Phase 6: mixed prompts, greedy, 128 new tokens each, no EOS stop. Methods run in an order rotated by one position per prompt; bandit engines run the block's prompts in order on one engine. Prompts are the fixed mixed set (mt_bench/121, humaneval/HumanEval/23, humaneval/HumanEval/24, humaneval/HumanEval/47, mt_bench/131, mt_bench/81, mt_bench/151, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/9:docstring, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/12:docstring, humaneval/HumanEval/34, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/0:docstring, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/8:type_hints, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/1:rename, mt_bench/111, humaneval/HumanEval/27, mt_bench/91, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/5:docstring, mt_bench/141, humaneval/HumanEval/45, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/3:type_hints, mt_bench/92, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/11:type_hints, humaneval/HumanEval/83, humaneval/HumanEval/85, mt_bench/82, mt_bench/101, humaneval/HumanEval/55, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/6:rename, humaneval/HumanEval/53, humaneval_edit/HumanEval/10:rename), tokenized as one user turn through the target's chat template (generation prompt added).

cold_start.source: wall time of this method's first generate in this block (synchronized); a FlashSpec method's first call in a fresh wrapper group includes torch.compile and CUDA-graph capture

method_order: rotated by one position per prompt

outputs.hash: sha256 of the token ids as decimal text joined by ','

forward_counts.source: derived: a hook would force the compiled forward to recompile

nonfinite_logits.scope: not checked: a forward hook would force the compiled forward to recompile

bandit.state: carried across this block's prompts on one engine

catch_up.definition: model-drafter steps whose first draft call forwarded more than 2 pending tokens (its own leftover is at most 2)

arm_report.reward_definition: emitted tokens / step seconds, per step (what the bandit sees); tokens_per_second is total emitted / total seconds

compile.decision: compile=auto: CUDA device cuda:0 and Triton 3.6.0 are available

cuda_graphs.source: torch.cuda.CUDAGraph.capture_begin calls while this method ran (warmup and measured generations); one per recorded CUDA graph

greedy_tie_check.rule: allowed exact tie: float16; both replays reproduce the recorded outputs; same tokens before the divergence; the two diverging tokens are the top-2 ids of both rows; one row's top-1/top-2 margin is exactly 0.0 (bundle 125d1a1 width diagnostic, #47)
greedy_tie_check.scope: untimed replays after the block; later blocks' cumulative call-shape counts include them
